summary: Resets suspension and wheel physics state. Zeroes a variable-length list of 24-byte blocks hanging off this+0x15B0 (count at this+0x15AC) by copying a zeroed 6-dword temporary into each block at +100 and calling Copy6DwordsToStructCall on it; zeroes four per-wheel suspension block pairs (2 dwords each, advancing 281 dwords per wheel) starting at this+0x348; and zeroes two contiguous 12-dword ranges, this+0xEC..0x118 and this+0x1F04..0x1F30.

operations.description: Only run the buffer-list reset when the item count at this+0x15AC is greater than zero.

Loop over this+0x15AC buffer items advancing 580 bytes per item; per item copy 0x18 zero bytes to (block pointer at this+0x15B0) + 100 + offset, then feed the zeroed dwords to Copy6DwordsToStructCall.
Call Copy6DwordsToStructCall on the zeroed 6-dword temporary buffer.
Four iterations over per-wheel suspension block pairs starting at this+0x348, advancing 281 dwords per iteration; zero both dwords of each pair (this+0x348 and this+0x34C for the first wheel).
Zero the 12-dword suspension state range this+0xEC through this+0x118.
Zero the 12-dword secondary suspension state range this+0x1F04 through this+0x1F30.
Return the pointer to the first per-wheel block (this+0x348).
